title: queue/relay_queue: .map_or(false, ...) should be .is_some_and(...)
description: queue.rs lines 363, 386, 403 and relay_queue.rs lines 475, 513, 548, 553, 690 (all in test blocks): extension().map_or(false, |x| x == ext) is the pre-1.70 idiom. Since Rust 1.70 the idiomatic form is extension().is_some_and(|x| x == ext). Clippy flags this as clippy::option_map_or_none.
